title: The Tonic Chaleo Yoovidhya Sold to Thailand's Truck Drivers
conflicts: Birth year 1923 (Independent, The Week) against 1932 (BBC, citing local media); both given. TC Pharmaceutical founded 1956 as an import partnership (company profile) against 1962 (AP, BBC); both given. Launch year 1976 (Independent, The Week, Wikipedia) against the company profile, which says TC Pharmaceutical Industries was formed in 1978 to develop the product and 'later launched' it; the story uses 1976 and does not tie the launch to the 1978 company.
notes: Chaleo gave no interviews for the last 30 years of his life, so there is no founder quotation and no inner thought; his reasoning about taste is the company's own account, attributed. The Lipovitan-D ranking is The Independent's alone and attributed. Wikipedia used once, for the gaur name. The stance is 'complicates': the Gita's praise of measured rest sits against a drink sold to keep tired workers going. The company profile is an Internet Archive copy; archive.org was intermittently unreachable during checking but loaded on retry.
